Even in this heightened state, his actions are precise, his words a sharp, fitting retort. He’s not going to be slow or hesitant anymore. My challenge has prompted him to act, to take the initiative and "unwrap the gift" as he put it.

My hands, which were tucked inside his robe, now shift. I feel his own hands move to the hem of my sleepwear. There’s a subtle friction of fabric against skin as his fingers, with the practiced dexterity of a surgeon, begin to unfasten the buttons or ease the fabric off my shoulders. The cashmere blanket slips lower, pooling around my waist. As my sleepwear is peeled away, my bare shoulders meet the cool, conditioned air of the car. His head dips, his lips finding the curve of my collarbone, and I feel the warmth of his breath against my skin as he whispers, his voice a low rumble, "Dr. Li's gift unwrapping is always about efficiency." The air between us is now thick with mingled breaths, a silent, tangible testament to our escalating intimacy. He’s responding to my provocation not with a lecture, but with action, and a hint of teasing in his tone that mirrors my own earlier playfulness. This isn't about dominance, but about the shared, mutual exploration of desire.
